model: RapidOCR 3.10.0, Korean PP-OCRv5 mobile, ONNX Runtime 1.32.0
input: Photos selected through Chromium. Original JPEG bytes unless file is larger than 6 MiB or 16 MP, then canvas JPEG, max edge 1680, quality .94. Previous and improved API received identical bytes.
scoring: Correct means line, current station, arrow and toward all match. The ten hold examples are controls from outside the supported network or photographs without a single displayed direction. The other 15 include one-neighbour and branch signs.
latency_method: Localhost, one file per multipart request; upload through JSON response. Both servers received one excluded warmup. Two shuffled rounds (seed 20261120), alternating which server received each image first. No requests in parallel. A worker stays warm on the improved server.
